name: NoRegress
description: Evaluate a suite of AI outputs with NoRegress and fail the pipeline when the AI got worse.
author: Miloš Vujčić

inputs.name: suite
inputs.label: Suite file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the suite file, relative to the repository root. The file is a POST /evaluate request body with a "cases" array.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: NoRegress API key. Pass it from a secret variable, for example $(NoRegressApiKey).

inputs.name: serviceUrl
inputs.label: Service URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the NoRegress API, without /evaluate. Set it only for a self-hosted API.

inputs.name: batchSize
inputs.label: Batch size
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum cases per request. Match the API's case limit if a self-hosted API changed it.

inputs.name: junitFile
inputs.label: JUnit file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where to write the JUnit XML results, relative to the repository root. The task publishes it to the run's Tests tab.

outputVariables.name: outcome
outputVariables.description: passed or failed. An incomplete evaluation is failed.

outputVariables.name: inconclusiveCases
outputVariables.description: Number of cases the judge could not grade.

outputVariables.name: notGradedCases
outputVariables.description: Number of cases whose rules were all skipped.

outputVariables.name: junitFile
outputVariables.description: Absolute path of the JUnit XML file.
